source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Profit before tax, profit for the year and the restated cost of sales, operating profit and net finance income: University Press Plc audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 2026, N'000, printed page 12 (file _ngx_pdf/UPL.pdf page index 27). Profit from operations 338,161 plus finance income 51,359 equals profit before taxation 389,520; profit before taxation less income tax 175,847 equals profit for the year 213,673. | FY2025 cost of sales and the earnings per share row: University Press Plc audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 2026, N'000, printed page 12 (file _ngx_pdf/UPL.pdf page index 27). Cost of sales 1,445,023 for FY2025 reproduces the stored gross profit: 3,402,471 less 1,445,023 equals 1,957,448. Earnings per 50k share is printed in kobo, 49.53 for FY2026 and 104.45 for FY2025, so the naira figure is the printed kobo divided by 100; each ties to the stored profit for the year over 431,400,000 shares. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 2 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.source: University Press Plc audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 2026, N'000, printed page 12 (file _ngx_pdf/UPL.pdf page index 27). Cost of sales 1,445,023 for FY2025 reproduces the stored gross profit: 3,402,471 less 1,445,023 equals 1,957,448. Earnings per 50k share is printed in kobo, 49.53 for FY2026 and 104.45 for FY2025, so the naira figure is the printed kobo divided by 100; each ties to the stored profit for the year over 431,400,000 shares.
